pull_request.title: feat(review): Add review.stop_when_closed setting
pull_request.body:
Add `review.stop_when_closed`, on by default, settable per repository, workspace or organisation. A review still running when its pull request closes is stopped. Merged or not, a closed pull request is treated the same.

A queued review is cancelled. A running one is asked between passes, because work inside a thread cannot be stopped from outside it.
